notes: Tools and memory work properly now. Cleaner update screen, and a real way to quit the app.

changelog.headline: What's new in 1.0.5

sections.title: Tools and memory
items: Notes, reminders, tasks and the rest actually run now. Before this, some requests would get a friendly reply without anything really happening behind it.
Memory recall is back to full strength, so what you tell it stays found.

sections.title: Around the app
items: Update notices moved out of the small floating window. They now sit in the corner of the full app, and only when it is open.
There is a quit button in the top bar and in Settings. Closing the app now really closes it, with no leftovers in Task Manager.
The About section in Settings shows real details instead of placeholder text.

changelog.data_safety: Your chats, memory, notes, portfolio and settings stay exactly as they are. This update only replaces the app's own program files. Nothing you have created is touched or deleted.
